metadata.title: Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in machine-learning-based science

kapoor.verification_level: Published article metadata, summary and relevant introduction passages in the primary PMC record; author project documentation inspected.
kapoor.claim_scope: General concern that data leakage can produce overoptimistic results; no claim that this source validates the present protocol.

correction_check.searched: Exact-title correction/erratum searches restricted to publisher and NCBI records, and primary record inspected.
correction_check.caveat: Publisher direct access returned HTTP 403; verification uses the published primary article record in PMC. No absence-of-correction guarantee claimed.

prior_entries: Original 20 entries retained byte for byte; two entries added without duplicate keys. Correction notices are verification records, not additional manuscript citations.
